findings.title: Hardcoded `* 100` overcharges JPY and KRW by 100x
findings.explanation: PLANS includes jpy and krw, which have no minor unit. src/lib/money.ts says to always convert with the helpers and never multiply by 100. For example, team JPY with 1 seat gives 1800 * 12 * 0.9 * 100 = 1,944,000, but the correct amount is 19,440. Use `toMinorUnits(monthly * 12 * 0.9, currency)` so the conversion matches `monthlyPriceMinor`. Also add tests for the zero-decimal currencies.

findings.title: Floating-point discount math can produce off-by-one-minor-unit amounts
findings.explanation: `monthly * 12 * 0.9` uses binary floating point. The result can land just under or over a .5 boundary, so rounding can be off by one minor unit. Compute in integer minor units instead, for example `Math.round(monthlyPriceMinor(plan, currency, seats) * 12 * 9 / 10)`. Alternatively, define the discount as a named constant and round exactly once. Computing from `monthlyPriceMinor` also keeps checkout and invoice on one source of truth, which is the stated goal of the PR.

findings.title: Magic numbers for months and discount
findings.explanation: 12 and 0.9 are inline literals. Extract constants such as `ANNUAL_MONTHS = 12` and `ANNUAL_DISCOUNT = 0.1`. Alternatively, put the annual terms in PLANS so the pricing is configured in one place.

findings.title: No tests and no callers in this PR
findings.explanation: The description says checkout and the invoice generator use this function, but nothing in the repo calls `annualPriceMinor`. Add unit tests covering each currency, including JPY/KRW. Either wire up the callers or say that they come in a follow-up PR.

Review this pull request.

## Add annual plan pricing

Annual billing launches next month: twelve months for the price of 10.8 (a 10% discount). Adds `annualPriceMinor` next to the monthly price so the checkout page and the invoice generator compute it the same way.

## Diff

```diff
diff --git a/src/services/pricing.ts b/src/services/pricing.ts
index 142a18d..f738804 100644
--- a/src/services/pricing.ts
+++ b/src/services/pricing.ts
@@ -16,3 +16,9 @@ export function monthlyPriceMinor(plan: Plan, currency: Currency, seats: number)
 export function planLabel(plan: Plan): string {
   return plan === 'team' ? 'Team' : 'Business'
 }
+
+// Annual billing: twelve months with a 10% discount, in minor units for the invoice.
+export function annualPriceMinor(plan: Plan, currency: Currency, seats: number): number {
+  const monthly = PLANS[plan].monthly[currency] * seats
+  return Math.round(monthly * 12 * 0.9 * 100)
+}
```
